# RIFTBREK Vanguard - Module index (auto-generated)

All coordinates are **schematic-local**: x 0..767, z 0..767, y 0..223.  
World position = `origin + (x, y - 64, z)` when the schematic origin is pasted at world Y = **-64** (required so B12 fits above the world bottom).
Ground surface (first walkable layer) is local y = 96 = world y 32.
